purpose: Prepare the q27 RP-005 governed planning lane for review by making the incidence/pass-through, capacity, and per-1,000-liter scaling gaps explicit without mutating references or claiming q27 closure.
source_text_excerpt_policy: No long verbatim exam passages are embedded; official PDF evidence is cited by stable local source path and summarized.

official_source_evidence.question_source_summary: The official question asks whether a EUR 1 per 1,000 liter drinking-water levy counteracts overconsumption in dry summer months, using the graph in figure 1.
official_source_evidence.correction_model_summary: The correction model awards one point for reading that the levy raises the price to EUR 2 per 1,000 liter and creates a new equilibrium where Qv2 equals Qa2 at Q = 14,000, and one point for concluding that demand equals capacity so overconsumption is countered.

existing_governance_evidence.finding: A98 covers answer form, but D07 is not enough to close levy price/quantity/capacity and scaling coverage.
MTU-H3 narrowed D07 to tax afwentelingspercentage / percentage burden calculation and kept incidence-family mutation/product authority blocked.
MTU-H3A accepted D41/D42/D43/D45/D46 planning directions only; execution remained unauthorized.
D08 matches the topic of heffing tegen overconsumptie, but its current procedure imports elasticity/A15 and a percentage demand-reduction route not required by the official q27 correction model.
A88 supports scale labels such as x 1,000 in graph labels and final answers, but the current H5 fixture does not map it and the lane still needs reviewed scaling coverage.

operation_decomposition.answer_model_summary: Read from the graph that the levy leads to price EUR 2 per 1,000 liter and a new equilibrium at Qv2 = Qa2 with Q = 14,000.
operation_decomposition.answer_form_hook: A98 covers the leg-uit-of answer form, but not the levy graph/capacity operation itself.
operation_decomposition.misconception_hook: Do not confuse the EUR 1 levy amount with the new price, and do not ignore the Q = 14,000 capacity comparison.
operation_decomposition.scale_hook: The graph and answer use EUR per 1,000 liter; scale/unit handling must remain explicit.
operation_decomposition.procedure_hook: D07's percentage-pass-through procedure is not semantically sufficient for price/quantity/capacity reasoning.

operation_decomposition.answer_model_summary: Conclude that demand equals capacity, so overconsumption is countered.
operation_decomposition.answer_form_hook: A98 supports stating the yes/no direction and the reason.
operation_decomposition.misconception_hook: Do not stop at a price rise; the conclusion depends on demand equaling capacity.
operation_decomposition.scale_hook: The conclusion depends on reading the same quantity scale as the capacity line.
operation_decomposition.procedure_hook: D08 is topic-adjacent but imports elasticity/A15 reasoning not present in the correction model, so semantic-fit review is required before using it as closure.

unit_semantic_fit.semantic_scope: Supports leg-uit-of answer construction: choose direction or yes/no outcome, then give the economic reason.
unit_semantic_fit.does_not_cover: Does not by itself cover the levy graph, incidence/capacity operation, or per-1,000-liter scale.

unit_semantic_fit.semantic_scope: Supports using scale labels such as x 1,000 in graph labels, formulas, and final answers.
unit_semantic_fit.does_not_cover: Does not by itself cover incidence/pass-through or the capacity conclusion.

unit_semantic_fit.semantic_scope: Supports labeling tax wedge and consumer/producer price positions in a P-Q diagram after a levy.
unit_semantic_fit.does_not_cover: Does not by itself decide whether overconsumption is countered.

unit_semantic_fit.semantic_scope: Supports finding the new equilibrium after a levy.
unit_semantic_fit.does_not_cover: Does not by itself handle the scale/capacity conclusion or answer-form wording.

unit_semantic_fit.semantic_scope: Its topic is heffing tegen overconsumptie.
unit_semantic_fit.rejection_reason: The current D08 procedure imports A15 elasticity and percentage demand-reduction reasoning not required by q27's official correction model.

unit_semantic_fit.semantic_scope: Narrowed tax pass-through percentage / burden-share calculation.
unit_semantic_fit.rejection_reason: q27 asks whether the levy produces a price/quantity/capacity outcome that counters overconsumption, not an afwentelingspercentage.

dry_run_operation_candidate.label_nl: Heffing, schaal en capaciteit gebruiken om overconsumptie te beoordelen

input_objects.description: Figure 1 demand and supply for drinking water per month, including before/after levy lines, drought demand, and capacity line.

dry_run_operation_candidate.output_expectation: Explain whether the levy counters overconsumption by pairing the new price, new equilibrium quantity, capacity equality, and a yes/no conclusion.

required_steps.description: Read the post-levy price as EUR 2 per 1,000 liter.
Read the new equilibrium where Qv2 equals Qa2 at Q = 14,000.
Compare the new demand/equilibrium quantity with capacity.
State that overconsumption is countered because demand equals capacity.

unit_support_assessments.rationale: D41 supports tax wedge and price/quantity labeling in a P-Q diagram after a levy.
D05 supports finding the new equilibrium after a levy.
A88 supports explicit per-1,000-liter scale and unit handling.
D08 is topic-adjacent but currently imports A15 elasticity and percentage demand-reduction reasoning not required by q27.
D07 is tax pass-through percentage and does not close the q27 levy price/quantity/capacity operation.

live_review_assertion_markers: review whether D07 tax-burden percentage is insufficient for levy price/quantity/capacity operation
review whether per-1,000-liter scale/unit handling needs a dedicated MTU or reviewed equivalent
review whether this is an incidence/pass-through family case or a distinct levy-capacity operation
negative_regression_requirement.required_behavior: Any future q27 repair must fail or review-block if it hides the incidence/capacity gap, hides the per-1,000-liter scaling gap, or claims D07 alone closes q27.
must_preserve: D07 is rejected as q27 closure support
A88/D41/D05/D08 are reviewed as support or weak support before any mapper repair
live q27 H5 assertions remain visible until an approved later repair

packet_result.why_not_complete: This packet prepares q27 RP-005 for governed review. It does not authorize mapper repair, candidate writes, protected-reference mutation, MTU mutation, lesson output, diagnostics, PV, or product use.
